site: GitHub Docs Japanese passkeys, 4 unmodified captured pages
order: Within replicate, cyclic actor rotation; each block of 4 replicates balances all 4 positions. Not randomized.
intervention: Existing whole Persona JSON vs absent; same image, goal, source, unweighted user-mode profile, locale, initial state. No Persona-specific routes or forced actions.
primary: First-choice model-trial distributions, full observed trajectories, non-UI looks/reread/wait/back/abandon, and invalid/infrastructure/censoring counts. Four replicates descriptive; configurable100 does not mean400 executed.
objective: UNVERIFIED/null: information acquisition and understanding have no independent oracle. Subjective done and objective success kept separate.
stop: Immediate auth/quota/safety/frozen-source/accounting/audit failures; stop at 3 consecutive invalid trials; preserve all invalid prefixes without replacements. Interrupted ATTEMPTING is not rerun.
capture: Bounded live acquisition once; main trials replay recorded real-site HTML/CSS/assets offline without network fallback. Out-of-scope links unavailable, search/forms/login disabled; this is a scoped information exploration, not unrestricted site behavior.
analysis: Do not pool mock/pilot/real, incompatible source/config/goal/snapshot/initial states. Counts are model trials, not human behavioral frequencies; no single-path repeatability requirement or human fidelity claim.
revisionReason: Require embedded successful document body even with unknown size
Separate in-progress trial from invalid results in summaries and slot labels
Count recorded native schema-invalid responses for existing three-consecutive-invalid stopping rule
unchangedActorPolicy: Same profile, Persona JSON, goal, snapshot, viewport and12decision/36request bound; no model-output repairs or click-policy changes
